items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Illinois Jacquet, he was there, too... I think he plays magnificent.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was thirty dollars. So that was a yard I made for the whole thing. So he got straight behind it! And from then on... Well, he considered me a California boy, because that's where I met him, out in California. But I mean, I was really from New York, and I knew more about what was going on than he thought I did.

Anyway, he said, "Look, I want you to make a tour with me." So I said to myself, I know he ain't gonna pay me no money... I knew what he was paying Jacquet and I knew what he was paying the rest of the guys, so I sounded him. I said, "Yeah, well, okay, I don't mind making a tour for you, but I can't go for no California wages." So he said, "Oh no! We wouldn't go in for that. I'll take care of everything." I said, "Oh you will, huh?" "Yeah." So I said, "Yeah, okay."
